text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp went by in a flash, didn't it?
I learned so much... It was truly a wonderful time!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thank you, and great work to you too, Trainer-kun♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thank you, and great work to you too, Trainer-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't really get a chance to stream during camp, so I wonder how all my fans are doing?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I want to do a long stream once we get back.
There's just so much I want to talk about.
choice_data_list: Tons of supportive messages have been pouring in.

text_block_list.text: I had set up notifications for community posts throughout the summer training camp, and every single one was filled with encouragement.
They were warm, thoughtful, and overflowing with love for Loves Only You.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy...! I can't wait to tell everyone what an amazing training camp it was!
I watch Loves Only You run off with a bright smile, then gaze up at the sky. As the blazing sun begins to sink, our summer training camp draws to a peaceful close.
...I might be overthinking things, but the gloom in my heart refuses to lift.
What else can I possibly do for Loves Only You? That question continues to swirl inside my chest.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder where Trainer-kun went.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder where Trainer-chan went.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(You still had that troubled look on your face...
I really wanted to talk to you.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (...If I ask now, will you tell me? I don't want to force an answer out of you... but still.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, I guess I've got no choice!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's the final night of summer training camp, after all!
We have to end it on a high note with fun, happy memories!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, Trainer-kun.
I'm coming to find you right now!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, Trainer-chan.
I'm coming to find you right now!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Not around the lodge...
...In that case, the only place left is...)
choice_data_list: Uh... Loves' summer training camp has come to an end.

text_block_list.text: I hit the record button on my smartphone and start talking. I'm not actually livestreaming—it's just make-believe.
Imitating her won't magically give me the answers. It was an impulsive move, but it felt like a good way to organize my thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer-kun isn't... streaming, is he?
Looks like he's just recording a video, but...)
choice_data_list: She's a hardworking, fiercely dedicated Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer-chan isn't... streaming, is she?
Looks like she's just recording a video, but...)
choice_data_list: She's a hardworking, fiercely dedicated Umamusume.

text_block_list.text: I speak into my phone about how captivating Loves Only You is, and how full of love she is.
choice_data_list: Everything she does and says is so sincere and dazzling.

text_block_list.text: Being able to become her Trainer wasn't just because of my desire to support her, but also thanks to all her fans.
Taking a deep breath, I prepare to pour out the jumbled feelings in my heart.
Loves Only You, who let me take an essential first step as a Trainer. And the friends who gave me courage.
I want to know what kind of special love would be worthy of them. Not just the standard things I can do as a Trainer.
And yet, I don't know how to do that. No matter how much I think about it, no matter how hard I try to take action—
choice_data_list: Whatever I do, it feels like it lacks enough love...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (Lacks love...?)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...Trainer-kun.
Is that... what you've been agonizing over this whole time?)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...Trainer-chan.
Is that... what you've been agonizing over this whole time?)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: You've been carrying all of that... all by yourself, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...You want to repay those feelings.
Don't you realize just how precious that desire is?)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (—Ah, how could you...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Love me♡ Love you♡
It's Loves Only You~♡
Loves Only You suddenly bursts right into the smartphone camera frame.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Dropping in unannounced♪
Because this person here doesn't get it at aaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I've only done what any Trainer could do"?
..."I'm not showing enough love"?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Who was the one who brought all that love to me?
Who was the one who became that "bridge"?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: You chose me and became my Trainer. You connected me with so many people, and told me to keep running with those feelings in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Someone overflowing with this much love is standing right here.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: If we have a "bridge" that conveys love, don't you think we can receive even more love to push us forward from now on?
I slowly turn her words over in my mind, taking them in one by one. Those warm, gentle words.

...There was no need for a special love.
It's precisely because I'm a Trainer that I could become that "bridge."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Did you realize it, I wonder?

Even before I could realize it myself, she was the one who told me.
As I offer a relaxed smile and say thank you, tears glisten in her eyes as well.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...You really are a blessed one, aren't you?

Saying so, Loves Only You flashed a smile
brighter than the starry night sky.
